column4: A plain wooden signpost with two blank arrow boards pointing in different directions stands on a sunlit path under a bright electric blue sky, bright even light, slow camera push forward, calm polished motion, no text, no letters, no logos.

A plain wooden ladder leans against a bright electric blue wall, a person in a plain light shirt climbs it slowly seen from behind, bright even light, slow camera tilt upward, calm polished motion, no text, no logos.
